description: 对话消息流管线(从用户输入到AI回复的完整Pipeline)

stages.name: input_preprocess
stages.description: 用户输入预处理(去敏/安全检查/多模态附件)

stages.name: conversation_state_resolve
stages.description: 会话状态解析(会话是否存在/角色切换/会话摘要加载)

stages.name: prompt_assemble
stages.description: 提示词组装(system + context + history + user input)

stages.name: llm_stream
stages.description: LLM流式生成(通过chat/llm_client.go调用模型Provider)

stages.name: tool_detect
stages.description: 检测LLM输出中的tool_call，分发执行

stages.name: tool_result_inject
stages.description: 工具结果回填到对话历史，触发二次生成

stages.name: reply_sanitize
stages.description: 回复后处理(去重复/去标记化/句式断句)

stages.name: deliver
stages.description: 输出投递(SSE推前端/侧车投递通道)
